description: AI suggestions while typing, from your laptop or your own API key. Off until you pick a provider.
command.chooseProvider: Choose where AI suggestions come from
command.setApiKey: Set API key for AI suggestions
command.toggleProject: Turn AI suggestions on or off for this project
config.title: Diligent AI suggestions
config.provider: Where AI suggestions come from. Nothing is sent until you pick one and agree to the notice naming the service.
config.provider.apikey: Your own API key: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Mistral Codestral by default), Anthropic or Gemini.
config.laptopUrl: Ollama's address on your laptop, like `http://192.168.1.20:11434`. Ollama only listens to its own computer by default; starting it with `OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0` opens it to everyone on that Wi-Fi.
config.laptopModel: The Ollama model to use. A fill-in-the-middle code model works best.
config.apiFormat: Which kind of service your API key is for.
config.endpoint: The service's address. Empty uses Mistral Codestral, Anthropic or Gemini's own.
config.model: The model to ask. Empty uses the service's default code model.
config.maxTokens: The longest suggestion to ask for, in tokens.
config.wifiOnly: Suggestions only on Wi-Fi: nothing is sent on mobile data.
config.enabled: AI suggestions in this project. Turn off to never send this project's code.
config.contextBefore: How many characters before the cursor are sent.
config.contextAfter: How many characters after the cursor are sent.
